name: Broad looseflower sedge
desc: Broad looseflower sedge (Carex laxiflora): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Carex laxiflora, the broad looseflower sedge, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cyperaceae. It is native to eastern Canada and the central and eastern United States.
